title: What If You Traveled at the Speed of the Fastest Thing Ever Built?
subject: Parker Solar Probe

scenes.text: What if you could fly at the speed of the fastest thing humans ever built?
NASA's Parker Solar Probe hit 430,000 miles per hour on December 24, 2024.
That's about 192 kilometers every single second.
At that speed, you'd fly from Washington to Tokyo in under a minute.
It passed just 3.8 million miles above the Sun's surface, inside the Sun's atmosphere.
A heat shield only 4.5 inches thick is built to withstand nearly 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
